mainAdvance.title: fix(observability): stop paging on handled Workflow errors

semantics: The PostHog hourly error-spike query excludes only recognized handled Workflow hook 404, duplicate-event 409 and terminal-run 410 chains with a recognized successful root and matching service/trace/span ancestry.
Unmatched errors, transport failures and failed/missing entry traces remain eligible for the alert. The same filtering applies to current counts and historical baselines.

The repository query adopts per-span inverse sample-rate weighting, with a legacy 0.1 default, and a 50-span floor. Documentation and insight description describe that external observability calculation.
One existing ops test file adds an in-memory SQL regression test. It remains under the existing test:lib-units entry; package.json and test-entry wiring are unchanged.
